description: Implement all frontend pages, custom hooks, and the theme context. This feature wires the UI components from FEAT-002 to the backend API from FEAT-001 via the api utility and React hooks. Depends on FEAT-001 (API contract) and FEAT-002 (components and router).
steps: 1. Create packages/frontend/src/context/ThemeContext.tsx: React context with ThemeProvider. Reads 'theme' from localStorage (default 'light'). Toggling adds/removes 'dark' class on document.documentElement. Exports useTheme hook.

2. Create packages/frontend/src/hooks/useTrip.ts: custom hook. Exports useTrip(tripId?: string). Uses useState + useEffect to fetch GET /api/trips/:id on mount. Returns {trip, isLoading, error, refetch, updateTrip, deleteTrip}. updateTrip calls PUT /api/trips/:id and refreshes. deleteTrip calls DELETE and navigates to /trips.

3. Create packages/frontend/src/hooks/useStops.ts: exports useStops(tripId). Returns {stops, isLoading, error, addStop, updateStop, deleteStop, reorderStops, markVisited, skipStop}. addStop calls POST /api/trips/:id/stops. reorderStops calls PUT /api/trips/:id/stops/reorder. markVisited calls PATCH .../visit. skipStop calls PATCH .../skip. After each mutation, refetches the stop list.

4. Create packages/frontend/src/hooks/useRoute.ts: exports useRoute(tripId). Returns {routeCache, isLoading, isCalculating, error, calculateRoute, optimizeRoute}. calculateRoute calls POST /api/trips/:id/route/calculate and sets isCalculating during the request. Stores result in state.

5. Create packages/frontend/src/hooks/useGeocoding.ts: exports useGeocoding(). Returns {search, results, isLoading, error, clearResults}. search(query) calls GET /api/geocode/search?q={query}&limit=5. Debounces calls at 300ms. Cancels in-flight requests on unmount using AbortController.

6. Create packages/frontend/src/hooks/useProgress.ts: exports useProgress(stops: Stop[]). Pure computation hook — derives {totalStops, visitedCount, skippedCount, progressPercent, currentStop (first unvisited non-skipped), remainingStops} from the stops array. No API calls.

7. Create packages/frontend/src/hooks/useShare.ts: exports useShare(tripId). Returns {shareUrl, isShared, isLoading, enableShare, disableShare, regenerateLink}. enableShare calls POST /api/trips/:id/share and builds full URL from window.location.origin + /share/ + token. regenerateLink calls POST .../share/regenerate.

8. Create packages/frontend/src/pages/Landing.tsx: landing page at '/'. Hero section with headline 'Plan your stops. Enjoy the journey.', subtext about pandal-hopping use case generalized to multi-stop journeys. Two CTA buttons: 'Create a Trip' (-> /trips/new) and 'View Demo' (loads a hardcoded demo trip via useNavigate to /share/demo or a seeded share token). Three-step explainer with icons (MapPin, Route, Navigation). Sample itinerary preview card showing 3-4 pandal names. Responsive: stacks vertically on mobile.

9. Create packages/frontend/src/pages/Trips.tsx: page at '/trips'. Calls GET /api/trips (with X-Session-Id for guests). Shows LoadingSkeleton while loading, ErrorMessage on error. Renders list of TripCards. Empty state with 'Create your first trip' CTA. 'New Trip' button in top right. Uses useTrip hook's deleteTrip and duplicateTrip actions passed to TripCard.

10. Create packages/frontend/src/pages/NewTrip.tsx: page at '/trips/new'. Form with: trip name (required), optional description, optional start location (SearchCombobox), optional end location (SearchCombobox), travel mode selector (driving/walking/cycling with icons). On submit, calls POST /api/trips, navigates to /trips/:id on success. Client-side validation with Zod (same schema shape as backend). Inline field errors shown below inputs.

11. Create packages/frontend/src/pages/TripPlanner.tsx: main route at '/trips/:tripId'. Layout: desktop — 380px left sidebar + remaining map; mobile — map fills screen with a collapsible bottom panel. Left sidebar: trip name (editable inline), StopList with drag-and-drop, RouteStats, action buttons (Add Stop, Calculate Route, Share, Start Trip). Map area: MapContainer with NumberedMarker for each stop, RoutePolyline if routeCache exists, map auto-fits bounds to all markers on load. Add Stop action: opens a mini-modal with SearchCombobox, selecting a result adds the stop. Selecting a stop in the list highlights both the list item and its map marker. 'Start Trip' button navigates to /trips/:tripId/navigate.

12. Create packages/frontend/src/pages/TripNavigate.tsx: mobile-first execution page at '/trips/:tripId/navigate'. Top bar: trip name + 'X of N stops' progress. Map occupies top 60% of viewport showing the route and current stop marker (centered/pulsing). Bottom section: current stop card (name, address, notes, estimated visit time). Large primary 'Navigate' button (opens Google Maps via buildGoogleMapsUrl). Secondary buttons: 'Mark Visited' (calls markVisited, advances to next stop), 'Skip' (confirm dialog then skipStop). Below the current stop: next stop preview card. Shows ProgressBar. If all stops done: 'Trip Complete' celebration state with button to return to planner.

13. Create packages/frontend/src/pages/ShareView.tsx: public page at '/share/:shareToken'. Calls GET /api/share/:token. Shows read-only trip title, stop list with numbered markers, interactive map with all stops and route polyline, route stats. 'Open in Google Maps' button builds a Google Maps URL for the full trip (first stop as origin, last as destination, up to 9 intermediate waypoints via /dir/ URL format). 'Copy Link' button copies current URL. No edit actions. Never shows owner information. Works without auth.

14. Create packages/frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: page at '/settings'. Theme toggle (light/dark) using useTheme. Display preferences section. If auth token present: shows user email, logout button. Account section: login/register links if not authenticated. Simple card layout.

15. Update packages/frontend/src/router/index.tsx to ensure: all 7 routes are defined, Layout wraps the main routes (/, /trips, /trips/new, /trips/:tripId, /trips/:tripId/navigate, /settings) as children, /share/:shareToken renders without the Layout (standalone public page), React.lazy is applied to each page component, Suspense fallback is <LoadingSkeleton variant='map-panel' />.
16. Ensure packages/frontend/src/App.tsx integrates ThemeProvider (from context/ThemeContext) wrapping RouterProvider, so useTheme is available everywhere.
acceptance_criteria: cd packages/frontend && npm run build exits 0 with FEAT-003 pages in place
cd packages/frontend && npm test passes all existing component tests from FEAT-002 (no regressions)
No TypeScript errors across all pages and hooks
TripNavigate page has a Navigate button that calls buildGoogleMapsUrl and opens Google Maps
ShareView page renders stop list and map without any owner.email or owner.password reference in the component
findings: All 16 steps implemented. Key decisions: (1) ThemeContext already existed at src/contexts/ThemeContext.tsx from FEAT-002 — not duplicated, existing file reused. (2) App.tsx already wraps RouterProvider in ThemeProvider from FEAT-002. (3) Router already has ShareView outside Layout group from FEAT-002. (4) useGeocoding uses AbortController for in-flight cancellation and 300ms debounce via setTimeout refs. (5) useProgress is a pure useMemo hook with no API calls. (6) TripPlanner uses md: Tailwind breakpoints for 380px sidebar (md:w-[380px]) + collapsible mobile bottom panel — no JS media queries. (7) StopList drag-and-drop uses HTML5 native draggable API, onReorder fires only on dragEnd. (8) TripNavigate Navigate button calls buildGoogleMapsUrl from src/utils/navigationUrl.ts. (9) ShareView never references owner.email or owner.password. (10) All form fields have <label> with htmlFor. (11) Zod not available in frontend package — client-side validation done inline without external schema library. Both verifications exit 0: npm run build (tsc + vite, 1559 modules), npm test (17/17 tests pass).
